name: R0iZ Domain Monitor Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted domain expiration monitor with unlimited domains documented in upstream README; automated WHOIS/RDAP checks and email, Telegram, Discord, Slack and webhook alerts. No vendor software subscription or expiry.
watch_out: Requires own PHP 8.1+ hosting, database, scheduled cron, backups, HTTPS and secure configuration; SMTP and third-party notification services may charge. WHOIS/RDAP coverage varies by TLD. This is free software, not free hosted monitoring. Independently maintained fork of Hosteroid/domain-monitor.
